{"CommandLine":"# Stop Ollama temporarily
Stop-Process -Name "ollama" -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Start-Sleep -Seconds 1

# Create target on E:
$ollamaSrc = "C:\Users\footb\.ollama"
$ollamaDst = "E:\.ollama"

Write-Host "Migrating Ollama ($ollamaSrc -> $ollamaDst)..."
robocopy "$ollamaSrc" "$ollamaDst" /E /COPY:DAT /DCOPY:DAT /R:2 /W:2 /MT:16 /NFL /NDL /NP

# Verify
$srcCount = (Get-ChildItem -Path $ollamaSrc -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum)
$dstCount = (Get-ChildItem -Path $ollamaDst -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum)

Write-Host "Source: $($srcCount.Count) files, $($srcCount.Sum) bytes"
Write-Host "Target: $($dstCount.Count) files, $($dstCount.Sum) bytes"

if ($dstCount.Count -eq $srcCount.Count -and $dstCount.Sum -eq $srcCount.Sum -and $srcCount.Count -gt 0) {
    Write-Host "Ollama copy verified! Removing old C: directory and creating Junction..."
    Remove-Item -Path $ollamaSrc -Recurse -Force
    cmd /c mklink /J "$ollamaSrc" "$ollamaDst"
    [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable("OLLAMA_MODELS", "E:\.ollama\models", "User")
    Write-Host "Ollama junction created successfully!"
} else {
    Write-Host "Verification mismatch for Ollama, not removing source."
}

# Start Ollama back up
Start-Process "C:\Users\footb\AppData\Local\Programs\Ollama\ollama.exe" -ArgumentList "app" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
","Cwd":"C:\Users\footb","WaitMsBeforeAsync":10000,"toolAction":"Migrating Ollama (84GB) to E: drive","toolSummary":"Migrate Ollama to E:"}
